content.question: What does instance normalization normalize?
options: All activations of the network against a single global mean and variance.
Each instance separately, and within it each feature map (channel), treating each channel and each example independently.
The weights of the first layer only.
The gradients of the loss with respect to the batch.
content.answer: Each instance separately, and within it each feature map (channel), treating each channel and each example independently.
